title: RBI Monetary Policy Keeps Repo at 5.25

blocks.content: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) held its bi-monthly meeting from 3 August 2026 to 5 August 2026. On 5 August 2026, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra announced that the repo rate would remain unchanged at 5.25%, marking the fourth consecutive meeting at this level since December 2025.

items: The RBI follows a flexible inflation targeting framework with a medium-term target of 4% Consumer Price Index inflation.
The MPC consists of six members, including three members appointed by the Government of India and three members from the RBI.
The repo rate is a key policy rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility of the RBI.
The Standing Deposit Facility and Marginal Standing Facility are part of the RBI’s liquidity management corridor.
